content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision (the Section 2 licence grant imposes no separate non-transferability restriction, and the Agreement contains no change-of-control clause, so there is no Vendor termination or re-pricing right on our change of control). The clause is mutual and carves out affiliate assignments, but it fails the fallback on two material terms: there is no successor/M&A carve-out, so a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of our assets would require TrueLink's approval, and the consent standard is unqualified rather than "not unreasonably withheld" — approaching the walk-away position of a prohibition on Customer assignment with no M&A carve-out. Our redline makes the smallest edit to reach the preferred position: it adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for Client, a reasonableness standard on consent, and a bar on TrueLink transferring the Agreement to a Client competitor, while preserving the existing mutual structure.

proposal.summary: Add Client affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, reasonableness standard on consent, and bar assignment by TrueLink to a Client competitor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and a reasonableness standard on consent, so a corporate transaction cannot be blocked. We also confirmed TrueLink may not transfer the Agreement to one of our competitors.

ops.oldText: without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment by Client to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer this Agreement, in whole or in part, to a competitor of Client.
